hooks.command:
python3 -c "
import json, sys, os
from datetime import datetime

data = json.load(sys.stdin)
sid = data.get('session_id', 'unknown')
ts = datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d-%H%M%S')

os.makedirs('docs/superpowers/logs', exist_ok=True)
fname = f'docs/superpowers/logs/{ts}-session-log.md'

with open(fname, 'w') as f:
    f.write(f'# Session Log: {ts}\n\n')
    f.write(f'- **Session ID**: {sid}\n')
    f.write(f'- **Time**: {datetime.now().isoformat()}\n\n')
    f.write('## Changes Summary\n\n')

print(json.dumps({'systemMessage': f'Session log: {fname}'}))
"
